desc: The Rizzini BR220 is a versatile and elegant over-under shotgun, available in various gauges from 12 to .410. Featuring a coin-finished frame with game scene laser engraving and ornamental scrollwork, this shotgun boasts a finely crafted Grade 2.5 Turkish Walnut stock, with 26 LPI checkering and a rounded forend for superior grip. Built with Rizzini's renowned mechanics, including automatic ejectors and a single selective trigger, the BR220 offers exceptional performance and durability. The gun is complemented by a set of nickel-coated flush chokes and an ABS case for safe storage. A true blend of craftsmanship and reliability.
